summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py, rewired all modules to it, added tests/test_timeparse.py; existing tests pass (also under another TZ). Behavior change: OverflowError/OSError from absurd epoch or date values now surface as ValueError (clean data error) instead of a crash, per the guide; quirks like two-digit negative years and 24:00 kept as-is.
